visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with two small pigtails, wearing a grey t-shirt and blue denim shorts, stands in a brightly lit indoor living area next to a wooden shelf and chest of drawers. She holds a white crocheted rabbit toy wearing a yellow dress and looks up toward an adult whose legs are visible. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the girl's face as she clutches the rabbit toy near her chin, her expression focused and slightly pouting. (3) The girl turns and walks away from the camera across a light-colored wooden floor, passing a white robot vacuum station on the right. (4) The girl reaches a large white beanbag chair next to a grey floor mattress, climbs onto it, and meticulously arranges a white, red, and blue patterned blanket over herself and the rabbit. (5) She lies flat on the beanbag with the blanket up to her chin, closing her eyes and raising her arms in a mock sleeping pose. (6) Moments later, she bursts into a wide smile, sits up quickly, and lifts the rabbit toy high above her head with both hands in a celebratory gesture. (7) An animated end screen appears featuring a cartoon version of the girl on a solid pink background with white text.
